mostWorthwhile.text: Building the water-resistant surface was most worthwhile: it showed how cells and fats slow water loss without stopping it entirely.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the sweat gland to its named slot felt straightforward but repetitive after already joining the coil and duct.

surprise.text: The outer skin reduced water loss rather than stopping it completely, and new cells replace those shed at the surface.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and named slots explained where the parts belonged, although several later combinations were the only available action.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how another body system connects to the model, though the mostly straightforward fittings made this chapter less compelling as a puzzle.
